rule_text: No changes after Wave 14 except defects, security fixes, or paying-client-critical blockers.
No new agents before first-client onboarding feedback.
API contracts remain stable through launch unless a critical defect requires correction.
UI implementation must consume the certified contracts without changing intelligence logic.
Demo journey, proof points, and executive story remain the launch baseline.
UI/UX implementation is permitted after Wave 14 as part of launch and onboarding execution.
First-client onboarding becomes the primary development and business priority after Wave 14.
